step2.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to the DLC3 connector.
Read the DTCs following the display screen of SST (TaSCAN).

atten3.ptxt: If there is a malfunction, after repair, check the DTCs again and confirm that no malfunction codes are output.

step2.ptxt: Using SST, connect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of the DLC3 connector.

atten3.ptxt: Connecting the connector to the wrong position will cause a malfunction, so never make a mistake.

step2.ptxt: Read the number of blinks of the 'P/S warning light' on the combination meter.

item.ptxt: If normal, the light repeatedly illuminates for 0.25 seconds and goes off for 0.25 seconds (2Hz blinks).

If there is 1 malfunction code, the same code is displayed at 4-second intervals. If there are multiple malfunction codes, the different codes are displayed at 2.5-second intervals, and after one cycle, they are output again after 4 seconds.
If multiple codes are output, they are output in order starting from the lowest code number.

step2.ptxt: Disconnect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of the DLC3 connector.

atten3.ptxt: If there is a malfunction, after repair, check the DTCs again and confirm that no malfunction codes are output.

step2.ptxt: Clear the DTCs following the display screen of SST (TaSCAN).
Using SST, with terminals 12 (TS) and 4 (CG) of the DLC3 connector connected, turn the IG ON, and connect and disconnect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) 4 times or more within 8 seconds.

item.ptxt: Connecting the connector to the wrong position will cause a malfunction, so never make a mistake.
Clear the DTC memory while the vehicle is stopped.
